description: Turn TikTok, Instagram, Xiaohongshu/RedNote, Douyin, and social-search demand into short-form video ideas, creator briefs, content plans, and discoverability insights.

interface.shortDescription: Plan social video from social-search demand.
interface.longDescription: Find what audiences search for across TikTok, Instagram, Xiaohongshu/RedNote, Douyin, YouTube Shorts, and other social platforms. Identify content gaps and competitor patterns, then turn the evidence into short-form video concepts, creator and UGC briefs, social plans, and discoverability reporting.
defaultPrompt: Find what people search for on TikTok, Instagram, RedNote, and Douyin, then show the content gaps.
Turn social-search demand into a short-form video and carousel plan.
Benchmark competitor videos and draft a creator or UGC brief.
